Dialogs.Dialog: Okay. I was just in the mood for that too.
Oh, good. Where should we go, then？
I want to, but... I have to get home early today.
Too bad... Guess we'll just head straight home, then.
That's the place, then. Come on, let's go.
There, huh... Well, if you want to go, I guess I can't complain.
I don't really have time for a detour. Can't we just walk home together？
Got it. Let's just head straight home, then.
Hmm... So you like that place. Well, I don't mind.
How did you even come up with that？ No way I'm going... Bye.
Hey... Want to stop somewhere on the way home？
Oh, bummer. How about just walking home together, then？
(Crap... It's past the time we were supposed to meet...)
You're late... You should be grateful I came to get you.
Shoot! It's past our meeting time...
So you were still here. Making your girlfriend come pick you up... You fail as a boyfriend.
Ah! It's past the time we were supposed to meet...
Don't "Ah!" me. I came to get you.
▲主人公＊▲. Don't tell me... you forgot our plans？
Oh, ▲小早川＊▲. I was just about to head over.
▲主人公＊▲. I came to see the panicked look on your face.
Huh？ It's not even time yet.
I came all the way to your classroom. So, how does it feel having your girlfriend come get you？
▲小早川＊▲! Sorry, were you waiting long？
"Sorry, were you waiting long？" Look at you two lovebirds.
Hey! Don't go blabbing about this, okay？
Man, your friend sure has a lot of energy.
▲小早川＊▲. Sorry to keep you waiting.
Yo, you two. Walking home together？ Hot stuff!
Quit teasing us and get lost already.
Your friend uses some pretty retro expressions... Well, he's funny, though.
▲小早川＊▲! Sorry, did I keep you waiting？
Nope. I don't mind at all.
Hey, Kobayakawa. How about being that nice to us, too？
What are you talking about？ You're an idiot.
(Huh, ▲小早川＊▲ can talk pretty normally with the guys in her class, too.)
You two. What are you doing out here？
We're just discussing library committee business. Is there a problem？
Oh, I see. Well, keep up the good work with the committee.
You two are keeping things appropriate for high school students, right？
I don't know what's inappropriate for high school students. Could you tell me？
Uh, no... Well, that's fine, then.
Well, if it isn't Kobayakawa. And you're that second-year...
Oh... Um, he's my senior on the library committee.
Yes. I was just asking him for advice on running the library. Excuse us.
Go on and get it, ●. I'll wait right here.
Nah, it's fine. Without my textbook, I'll have an excuse for not doing the homework.
(Pretty sure that won't fly as an excuse...)
Oh! I left something in the classroom...
Want to go back and get it？
Hmm, nah. It's nothing important anyway.
I forgot the handout we got today... Will you come back to the classroom with me？
Sure. I rarely get to see the first-year classrooms, so I'm kind of looking forward to it.
Oh, wait... Never mind, here it is. It was tucked inside my Japanese notebook.
Oh... Well, that's kind of disappointing...
Hey, isn't that a second-year homeroom teacher over there？
Yeah, it is... Is that a first-year with him？
A girl from the class next door... How suspicious...
Haha, it's probably nothing like that.
Oh... That couple over there, they're both the class reps for my homeroom.
They're always nagging me about the school rules, yet look at them having fun.
Well, there's nothing wrong with dating, right？
What？ ...See a girl you're interested in or something？
No, ● just know her from my class—
Oh, someone's coming... Hey, he's from my class! Huh, an older girlfriend and younger boyfriend.
What gives...? Oh, that girl by the shoe lockers...
Yeah, a love letter or something, maybe？ It'd be rude to get in the way.
What is it...? Wait, are they... confessing their feelings？
Looks like it, and eavesdropping is in bad taste. Come on, let's get going.
▲小早川＊▲, what's got you so fidgety？
Mm... A friend from my class said she's confessing to an upperclassman today.
And that's making you nervous too, ▲小早川＊▲？ Brings back memories of your own, huh？
Leave me out of this. Come on, let's go.
(▲小早川＊▲... Huh？ She's talking to someone.)
▲主人公＊▲. You were here？ Let's get going.
Are you done talking over there？
Oh, he just asked for my name and number. I ignored him, though.
▲小早川＊▲. Were you just talking with someone？
Some third-year. He asked me for my name and homeroom.
As if. I threatened to kick him and he took off.
▲主人公＊▲. You're late. I just had quite the ordeal, you know.
Some random guy tried to hit on me.
Nothing happened. If you're that worried, don't leave me by myself.
Sorry to keep you waiting, ▲小早川＊▲.
Oh... *sigh* You could've taken a little longer.
A stray cat wandered in and I was playing with it. It ran off when it heard your voice, though.
Ah... Hey, don't call out so loudly all of a sudden. Look, it ran away.
A pretty calico cat. Maybe I'll go after it...
Sorry. Didn't you and ● have plans, though？
Yeah, it sneaks into school a lot. It's like it comes just to see me. So cute.
Huh, ● would've liked to see it too.
I found a pencil case on the ground...
Is there a name on it？
Who puts their name on their stuff in high school？
Good point... Let's drop it off at the faculty office, then.
I found a plastic folder. And it has a sticker of a band I like on it.
Huh, looks like they put it on themselves.
You can really feel the love. I wonder whose it is.
If we find out, you two might have the same taste.
I found a makeup pouch. If we turn this in to the faculty office, the owner's probably gonna get in trouble.
True... Should we just put it back where you found it？
Yes. Did you pick it up for me？ Thank you.
Oh, so it was a teacher's... Well, good thing we found the owner.
Huh？ Oh, sorry, I was listening to music.
Hey, what are you doing？ I'm over here, you know.
Oh, ▲小早川＊▲! Ah, hahaha, looks like I got the wrong person.
Mistaking someone else for your girlfriend is pretty rude, you know.
▲主人公＊▲. How did you know I was behind you？
Huh, impressive. The power of love？
It'll be bad if we get caught...
Rumor has it they make you write a twenty-page apology essay. Even though they don't bother reading it anyway.
Let's go another way and save ourselves the trouble.
Yo. Going on a date after school？ Man, I'm jealous!
Huh. So going on an after-school date with your girlfriend is something to brag about？
It's not the date I'm bragging about, it's my girlfriend.
...You actually say something nice for once.
My dad's been nagging me to come home early lately.
He's just worried about his daughter.
Maybe, but... I think he wants me to watch my brother so he gets time with Mom.
'Go buy some toilet paper,' she says. Asking a maiden on a date for toilet paper...
It's my mom. Sorry, hang on.
Hello？ Oh, Kai？ ...Yeah, okay, got it. ...Chocolate？ Alright, be a good boy then.
It was my little brother. He called from Mom's phone asking me to bring a treat.
Don't go looking for her. Come on, let's go.
Hm, a text. Sorry, hang on.
An online shop. 'The item you wanted is back in stock.' Hmm, what should I do...
Online shopping, huh？ I bet you get a lot of use out of that, ▲小早川＊▲.
Hello？ ...No, wrong number. ...Yes, that's right. ...Okay, goodbye.
You're way more polite than when ● calls...
Well, obviously. With you, the bare minimum is fine.
(Guess that just means she's comfortable with me.)
Ugh... I think my muscles are sore.
Sore muscles？ Did you work out or something？
Just cleaning the house... Maybe I'm getting old. Not as old as you, though.
Hey, can we stop by a convenience store later？
A treat for my brother. Apparently he's collecting the prizes in some candy.
Oh, nice. Collecting those is always fun.
Oh, right. Let me know if you spot a 100-yen shop on the way.
I heard something I paid 300 yen for is sold at the 100-yen shop. I refuse to believe it till I see it.
Well, I can't say I don't get how you feel.
...Wait, wasn't I on cleaning duty today？
Hmm, no, it should be next week. Yeah, right？
Like I said, asking ● isn't gonna help.
Yeah, really. Hi to you too, Senpai. I don't want to get in your way, so I'll get going.
(Why is it... running into my girlfriend's friends always makes me a little nervous.)
Hey, look. Isn't that girl's outfit cute？
Huh. I mean, I guess it's cute, sure...
Do you think it'd look good on me？
(Pretty sure she's in middle school, though... Maybe I'll keep that to myself.)
I'm kind of getting a craving for cup ramen.
Nope! Hmm, I'll just hold off until I get home. Thinking about it till then is torture, so cup ramen talk is officially banned from now on.
You're the one who brought it up...
I heard a new cafe opened up near the school.
Oh yeah？ Wanna check it out？
No way, it's probably full of kids from our school. You'd have to be a really in-your-face couple to pull that off.
Guess that's it for today... Feels like it's going to be a long night until tomorrow.
Call me if you get lonely.
Good work today. See you tomorrow.
No school tomorrow. Too bad that doesn't mean we get to spend more time together, though.
All right, tomorrow's a day off. Think I'll stay up late.
Since tomorrow's a day off, I think I'll just take it easy. See ya.
